versions.content: ReadMemoryByAddress Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x23 (ReadMemoryByAddress). Rationale: The service allows for accessing the content of a piece of memory on the server. This is a frequently used functionality. Use Case: The user wants to read memory content from the diagnostic server. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
